_comment: What each drawn weapon does in a fight, read by WeaponTable.
'default' is every level that does not say otherwise, and it is exactly what the
weapons did before this file existed: blade reach 96 (UtilityObject.TOOL_REACH), a
half-plane arc (180), a 270 ms swing, and no wear (uses 0 = never wears out). The
weapon probe checks those rows against the constants, so the two cannot drift.
'levels' overrides a row per level id, field by field. Dilim's rows are the tuning
sheet's starting numbers: uses / damage / reach px / arc degrees / cooldown ms.
'damage' is what an enemy loses per blow; Levels 1-3 count blows, not damage.
buntot_pagi is the one weapon that is not drawn: Lola's stingray-tail whip, from Dilim's
satchel. Its default row is the blades' so the merge has a base; only Dilim has it.
